name: HOG Farm
description: A 20-acre community farm in Brookhaven hamlet that began in 1996 as the Hamlet Organic Garden. From spring to fall it hosts outdoor music: a Tuesday open-mic Farm Jam, cookouts with cover bands and a yearly Americana music festival.

dancing.notes: Shows are outdoors on the farm grounds and guests bring their own chairs or blankets, so there is open space. The farm's listing for its Americana festival promised honky-tonk and fiddle tunes to get people dancing. Most Farm Jam nights are open-mic sets that feel more like a picnic than a dance. Events have rain dates.

evidence.note: The farm's 2025 Americana Festival listing: country and roots bands, with the headliner's honky-tonk set billed as music that will get you dancing.
Farm Jam open-mic night listing: local musicians, food vendors, bring your own chairs and reusable cups.
Seafood boil with a cover band; describes blankets on the grass on a summer evening.
